text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after Seiun Sky miraculously
takes the
Classic Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at my office to find a mountain of

cardboard boxes!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a fine morning to ya. I was just
helping myself
to a bit of your office
space.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that'd be the sea bream. Gramps
says eat it
and you'll be "breaming" with
joy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
He sure did. But really, what am I
supposed to do
with so much?
choice_data_list: All of this is from Grandpa?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I mean, I won the Triple Crown, so of course Gramps is over the moon, but come on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, he also sent me some stuff I've
been
asking about for ages, like this bait
and fishing
chair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Sky told me it was her
grandfather's
dream for her to win in the
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I know, right? It was such a close call, I tell ya. Just knew something fishy was going on...

text_block_list.name: Delivery Person
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... These boxes are for the
school—huh?!
They're all addressed to
this dorm... and to the
same person?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, could I take a look at these boxes
for a
second?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"To Seiun Sky"... Oh, that's Gramps, all
right.
Geez, look at all of this.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm actually the Seiun Sky these are

addressed to. I'd love for you to send
them to the
school, but instead of my
dorm...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Talk about too close for comfort!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Imagine, if I had just woken up a minute
later, I
would've been literally boxed in
my room.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I can't thank you enough! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, gotta get back to opening all
of these
up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You take care of the sea bream, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Welp, you gotta cook it while it's still
fresh. So...
thanks in advance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the fish and start heading to
the kitchen
when I remember I didn't ask
how she wanted it
cooked. So I turn
back, and...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you. Yup, uh-huh... Okay.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But, Gramps, what am I supposed to do
with this
bamboo rod? You don't expect
me to actually
fish with it.

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about?! In your
hands, you
could catch tuna or even a
marlin with that thing!
Go on and
surprise your ol' grandpa again!
choice_data_list: (Is she on the phone with her grandpa... maybe?)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Say what? You're out of your mind...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right. So you're saying if I fish up
something
incredible with this bamboo
rod, you'll come and
tousle my hair or
whatever?

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Of course I would! You don't even gotta
catch the
fish. I'm always in the mood to
tousle that head of
yours!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Guess I've got no choice then, hehe. But
don't
blame me if you throw your back
out!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, Gramps! The other
day, I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I decide I can just slowly simmer the
fish, and
turn back once again to head
to the kitchen.
